title: Weakening General Position in Signed Simplex Representations
statement: Can the requirement that every $(d+2)$-subset of the vertex set $V$ affinely span $\mathbb R^d$ be removed or weakened while retaining a signed representation of a compact polyhedron’s uniform measure by uniform measures on $(d+1)$-vertex simplices?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Structured Function Systems and Applications (2013), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2013/11, pp. 579--655](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2013/11)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open
